methods.label: Use the sum of all equations
methods.explanation: Adding the three equations gives \(6(x+y+z)=36\), so \(x+y+z=6\). Subtracting this from the second equation gives \(x+2y=5\); subtracting \(2(x+y+z)=12\) from the third equation gives \(x-y=2\). Solving these together gives \(y=1\), \(x=3\), and \(z=6-3-1=2\).
